name: k3y69b-haiku-tool-churn
goal: Haiku module workers stop rotating at startup when claude.ai connector tools load mid-session; context limits stay enforced

evidence: Session telemetry from four failed workers and the 16:2x replay: first request 26.8k all cache read, next 120.8k all cache write (tool prefix changed), then refusal at about 196k. Expected: connector tools do not join a module worker, and a changed tool list is not recharged in full.

The provider-session relay case sent only messages, never tools, and no test pinned the worker's MCP isolation; a single-turn CLI probe finishes before connectors load. New provider-request-gate tests cover tools appearing and changing mid-session, an oversized tool set, and the worker command.
ae7fb6a12f: both new tests fail (gate forwards 2 of 3 safe requests; command lacks --strict-mcp-config).
d4e4b55568: Claude worker command adds --strict-mcp-config; the gate fingerprints each tool and counts only new or changed definitions. Hard limit unchanged.
d4e4b55568: unchanged tests pass (loop record green).
